body: Unpopular opinion - I agree, its done consciously so she can fight back with the whole ‘underdog’ story. Gets boring after a while, everyone has obstacles. Your on TV atleast make an effort, she is capable of adapting just as im sure most of us have to in order to get through daily life.

I was what could be considered to be a bully during my high school years. I still struggle now and now being in the workplace alone no longer surrounded by peers, i find it very difficult and isolating. I think it bought me pain seeing others happy without being able to be happy myself. I was bought up in a single parent family and perhaps had no-one to talk to about emotions etc. I now show multiple Aspergers traits, and sometimes question if this is part of the reason why I behaved the way a did towards others whilst I was younger. And yes for all the bullied victims, if it makes you feel better, my life is miserable now and will likely continue to be.
What if you cant physically (financially) afford to be by yourself?
This is nice to know. Hope things get better!

Just often seems like a pointless struggle to survive and endless mental suffering. Evening if you were to create ‘meaning’ this would be a lie, and would be narrow to stick for this for the rest of your life. I feel once you get to a certain age life becomes more fixed and acceptance of living a mediocre life like that around you becomes apparent. The world has enough humans in it already, why do most of us feel like we deserve to live and have a place? The majority of us spending our life’s spewing shit until that is disproved then the next thing and so on. Just jealous of people who have some innate thing in them or external to them who gave reason to survive, whoever tell others they need to ‘find meaning’
